answer: Agent markets for atlas tiles, zephyr routing, or quartz assays can resist Sybil attacks via zero-knowledge passport proofs. Each epoch, an agent submits a zk-SNARK proving a state-issued NFC chip signed its key, plus a deterministic epoch nullifier capping each document at one identity without leaking holder data. Attackers thus must obtain distinct physical passports per identity. However, this remains vulnerable to paid identity brokers who rent real passports.
